text:
The Dunmarrow Canal Authority on 14 March 2031 formally announced the route and length of its planned canal tunnel, which will run for 4 kilometres.

The details appear in the Authority's Feasibility and Route Report (Revision C), presented at a public board meeting. The report sets the tunnel's budget at 620 million Dunmarrow crowns, with a planned build time of six years.

Marisol Ketteridge, the Authority's Chief Engineer, presented the findings to the board. According to the report, the 4-kilometre alignment was the route adopted following the feasibility study.

The announcement marks the first time the Authority has published a fixed length and route for the crossing. The Revision C document is the version on which the board's budget and timetable figures are based.

The Authority has not published any further figures beyond those contained in the report.
